Bug_Title: EI: May expose internal representation by returning reference to mutable object (EI_EXPOSE_REP)
Bug_Details:
Returning a reference to a mutable object value stored in one of the object's fields
exposes the internal representation of the object. 
 If instances
 are accessed by untrusted code, and unchecked changes to
 the mutable object would compromise security or other
 important properties, you will need to do something different.
Returning a new copy of the object is better approach in many situations.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the getInternalList method, which returns a direct reference to the internalList field. This allows external code to modify the internal state of the ExposeInternalRepresentation object.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the getInternalList method, which returns a direct reference to the internalList field. The test then calls showBug, which modifies the internalList through the exposed reference. The assertions check that the internalList has been modified, demonstrating the bug.
